Class ServerRequestObservationContext

java.lang.Object
io.micrometer.observation.Observation.Context
io.micrometer.observation.transport.ReceiverContext<jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest>
io.micrometer.observation.transport.RequestReplyReceiverContext<jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse>
org.springframework.http.server.observation.ServerRequestObservationContext
All Implemented Interfaces:
io.micrometer.observation.Observation.ContextView, io.micrometer.observation.transport.ResponseContext<jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse>
public class ServerRequestObservationContext extends io.micrometer.observation.transport.RequestReplyReceiverContext<jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse>
Context that holds information for metadata collection regarding Servlet HTTP requests observations.

此上下文还扩展了RequestReplyReceiverContext，以便在 HTTP 请求处理期间传播跟踪信息。
